senses.gloss: --said to be the cause of निवृत्ति। वा. २४. ८३.
(V)--the planet शनैश्चर with प्रकृति of Rudra. वा. ५३. ३२.

(VI)--a son of सम्ज्ञ; learned and great; antara of, constituting २८ yugas when राजऋषिस् rule at the end [page३-339+ ३०] of which a period of ४० yugas set in;
1: वा. १००. ५६; ९९. ४३५, ४५७-60; Vi. III. 2. 2.
offered the kingdom of earth after the epoch of चाक्षुष Manu; the first Manu had nine sons; finding at first that he could not create beings he caused a sacrifice in honour of Mitra and वरुण out of which came इडा or इला.
2: वा. ८५. 1-7.
